DRADIS_PROJECT_ID.description: Dradis Pro project ID to import. Issues and nodes are pulled from /pro/api/projects/{id}/issues and /pro/api/projects/{id}/nodes; the project ID is also sent in the mandatory Dradis-Project-Id header on every project-scoped request.

name: dradis
title: Dradis Pro
description: Dradis Pro REST API importer. Pulls issues (/pro/api/projects/{id}/issues) and nodes (/pro/api/projects/{id}/nodes) for the configured project and walks each node's evidence (/pro/api/projects/{id}/nodes/{node_id}/evidence) to determine which issues are observed where. Emits one Faraday host per Dradis node with its evidenced issues attached as vulnerabilities; issues with no node evidence are attached to a synthetic 0.0.0.0 host so the data is still imported. Severity is parsed from the issue's Rating / Severity field (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info — also accepts Informational and Moderate) and falls back to CVSS v3 bucketing when only a numeric score is available. Auth is `Authorization: Token token="<DRADIS_TOKEN>"`; the Dradis-Project-Id header is sent on every request. DRADIS_HOST is the Dradis Pro base URL.
